description: This file defines the MessageException class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which inherits from std::exception and provides a custom exception with a message string and a method to retrieve the message.

classes.name: MessageException
classes.description: A custom exception class that inherits from std::exception, encapsulating an error message and providing a method to access it.

methods.name: MessageException(const string& message, bool inclSysMsg = false)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and optional system message inclusion flag.

methods.name: Message()
methods.description: Returns the exception message as a TCHAR pointer.
